en: It's not the load that breaks you down, it's the way you carry it.
cn: 压垮你的不是担子有多重，而是你扛它的方式。

en: You don't have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
cn: 你不需要看到整个楼梯，只需迈出第一步。

en: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
cn: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。

en: Done is better than perfect.
cn: 完成比完美更重要。

en: You are what you do, not what you say you'll do.
cn: 你是你所做的事，不是你说要做的事。

en: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
cn: 跌倒七次，站起来八次。

en: Small daily improvements are the key to staggering long-term results.
cn: 每天进步一点点，长期结果会吓你一跳。

en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
cn: 做出伟大工作的唯一方法是热爱你所做的。— Steve Jobs

en: It always seems impossible until it's done.
cn: 在做成之前，事情总是看起来不可能。— Nelson Mandela

en: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become.
cn: 达成目标获得的东西，不如你在这个过程中变成的人重要。— Henry David Thoreau

en: Comparison is the thief of joy.
cn: 攀比偷走快乐。— Theodore Roosevelt

en: Action is the antidote to despair.
cn: 行动是绝望的解药。— Joan Baez

en: We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
cn: 我们在想象中受的苦比现实中多得多。— Seneca

en: Your value doesn't decrease based on someone's inability to see your worth.
cn: 有人看不见你的价值，不代表你的价值就降低了。

en: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
cn: 走得快，一个人走。走得远，一起走。

en: Happiness is not something ready-made. It comes from your own actions.
cn: 快乐不是现成的，它来自你自己的行动。— Dalai Lama

en: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
cn: 你不投的球百分之百不进。— Wayne Gretzky

en: Not all those who wander are lost.
cn: 不是所有流浪的人都迷路了。— J.R.R. Tolkien

en: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
cn: 伤口是光进入你的地方。— Rumi

en: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
cn: 做你自己吧，别人都有人做了。— Oscar Wilde

en: You can't go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending.
cn: 你回不到从前改开头，但你可以在现在开始改结局。— C.S. Lewis

en: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
cn: 困难之中藏着机会。— Albert Einstein

en: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
cn: 前进的秘诀就是开始。— Mark Twain

en: You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
cn: 你比你相信的更勇敢，比你看起来更坚强，比你想象的更聪明。— A.A. Milne

en: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
cn: 你真正想要的一切都在恐惧的对面。— George Addair

en: The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
cn: 你越安静，能听到的就越多。— Rumi

en: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
cn: 在你所在的地方，用你所拥有的，做你能做的。— Theodore Roosevelt

en: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
cn: 走得再慢都没关系，只要你别停。— Confucius

en: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
cn: 没人能让你觉得低人一等——除非你允许。— Eleanor Roosevelt

en: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
cn: 你忙着做别的计划时，生活已经发生了。— John Lennon
